title: A big-block robot
done: Beep boop! A robot with a big blue head and a red body.

steps.say: Lay it flat on the table. Top row, left to right: 2 gaps, a big blue square.
Next row down, left to right: an orange square, 2 big red squares, an orange square.
Next row down, left to right: an orange square, past the big square, an orange square.
Next row down, left to right: a gap, a green square, 2 gaps, a green square.
Next row down, left to right: a gap, a green square, 2 gaps, a green square.
Two purple triangles on top of the head, pointing up. Its antennas.
An orange triangle on the end of each arm, pointing out. Its hands.
